# Japanese fonts

Subsets of Adobe Source Han Serif/Sans Japanese (OFL 1.1); renamed to LP Japanese Serif/Sans. The original copyright and licence notices are retained. Japanese regional glyphs are intentional.

Regenerate with `python3 tools/shared/ui/prepare_japanese_fonts.py --source-dir <download-directory>` after changing the Japanese table. Source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in provenance.json; save their OFL licences as LICENSE-serif.txt and LICENSE-sans.txt in the source directory. Full originals stay outside Assets.
